_comment: LIVE, and they need the browser to themselves — one Chromium per profile, and the running server owns it. Stop the server first: `launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.asta.server`. That is not a testing inconvenience, it is the same single-writer limit that serialises Teams and Outlook in production, measured rather than assumed. Chats named here must be ones he has already read: opening a conversation marks it read, and consuming his unread markers to run a test would be worse than anything this catches.

cases.why: the watcher that was dead for fourteen and a half hours while every test stayed green. Measured at 7.4s on a warm pool.
he asked directly whether Asta can read an old message it has already seen. It can — 8 messages back to the previous evening, measured at 8.2s. This pins it.
the surface that kept working through the Teams outage and made it look like a Teams-specific fault. Measured at 12.3s.
